faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Tirunelveli recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the DCPU Tirunelveli recruitment is 13 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated office address before this deadline to avoid rejection.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the posts of Assistant cum Incharge Typist, Junior Assistant cum Typist, and Office Assistant under the District Child Protection Unit, Tirunelveli.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 42 years as of 01 September 2026. Applicants must ensure they meet this age criteria before submitting their application forms.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely on a temporary contract basis. The selected candidates will be appointed on a consolidated pay structure as per the rules of the District Child Protection Unit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Assistant post must have passed the 8th standard or an equivalent examination from a recognized board or institution.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: You need to download the application form from the official website www.tirunelveli.nic.in, fill it out, and send it via post to the District Children Protection Officer, District Children Protection Unit, District Collectorate, Kokkirakulam, Tirunelveli.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the DCPU Tirunelveli recruitment. Candidates can apply for the posts free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Assistant cum Incharge Typist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant cum Incharge Typist post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- on a consolidated basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of the submitted applications followed by a consolidated pay contract appointment process. No written exam details were specified.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with necessary documents should be sent to the District Children Protection Officer, District Children Protection Unit, District Collectorate, Kokkirakulam, Tirunelveli.
